scope: Tracked carbon-league reports, local full-game parent/candidate action tapes, GIT tree filenames and published code; absence claim is limited to these artifacts.
result: No exact previous complete original Master3s2 matchup using frozen v1, public sequential one isolated payment opportunity per each of original two windows, without a learned profitability or risk threshold. Closest forced-purchase interventions were genuine partial-state pairs; the original-v1 64-root portfolio is already tested.

available_at_action: own-seat public current observation and legally visible history
actual v1 complete joint command; focal planter's payable current square and price
prefix cash after reservations for other planters and approved recruitment, no friendly destination conflict
redecode tested opposite legal action, require one focal label change and no newly induced friendly collision
band and physical seat; current heavy-return load, productive footprint, nearest enemy planter distance are public
not_a_causal_online_selector: within-map ordinal changes target stratum and preference for old STOP vs move; external seed, window index and worker ID determine retrospective rank
enumerate entire future window before selecting minimum stratum mismatch/preferred action/hash; subsequent availability is unknown when actor must decide
one best root per window in two independent source games; approved pair confirmed by official original replies, purchase completion and signed future cash are labels unavailable for choosing
hypothetical continuation always v1 after sole root; it cannot establish effects of repeated intervention
root_inventory.history_recipe_true_prefix: For v1 movement, force focal NONE. For v1 NONE, root source ranked four possible deferrals with public distances, fitted value and label order. Opponent's simultaneous order is common across branches; never an input. All 64 stored roots rechecked can_pay_now/payable_site/no_friendly_conflict and isolate one focal physical command.

usable_single_contrast.parents: Same shipped v1 in both arms on every turn and throughout both windows.
usable_single_contrast.online_replacement_for_retrospective_sam: At the first public, isolated eligible root in each inclusive fixed window, candidate selects pay. A v1-already-paying root consumes that window's quota, preserving opportunity denominators. Fix one deterministic public uid order for simultaneous opportunities, e.g. physical prefix order. At most two root intents/game; none if no qualifying root. All other acting is v1.
usable_single_contrast.treatment_difference: Only a parent's moving choice can become one stationary payment command. No profit, tree age, safety or retrospective outcome filtering; retain old prefix feasibility and collision checks. Both plant and seize are covered, whether the instruction actually settles is recorded.
usable_single_contrast.interpretation: New trial estimates this online policy on previously unseen development maps. Historical +57.45 and +106.24 must not be used as an unbiased estimate of the streaming trigger nor as a pass threshold. Two maps and eight games cannot support a population strength or formal checkpoint claim.

prior_experiments.name: Current v1 terminal interventions at all 64
prior_experiments.exposure: paired root only, each branch returns to v1 on following turn
prior_experiments.difference_from_source_always_pay: Only one isolated actor change in each branch. The 64 interventions were never composed across a game from t0. Current native root all-pay evidence is exactly this portfolio.

prior_experiments.name: Orchard
prior_experiments.exposure: genuine full four games against original Master3s2 on a different actor
prior_experiments.difference_from_source_always_pay: Adds STOP only when predicted net >50, prefix cash >=price+90, a safe square and bounded net/logit gap; can also cancel STOP for net <−25. Evaluates each turn; no two-window intent quota.

prior_experiments.name: Forced orchard purchase vs walking
prior_experiments.exposure: six middle-game roots from ladder; frozen mixed Sapling policy closes for both sides
prior_experiments.difference_from_source_always_pay: A compelled purchase is the same first-step action. Alternate is movement but trial conditions, opponent, scope differ. Selected roots have no ongoing from-opening policy.

prior_experiments.name: Canopy timing (including recalibrated version)
prior_experiments.exposure: native v1 action census + outcome forecast and abstention; no whole native blanket-pay experiment
prior_experiments.difference_from_source_always_pay: Middle-phase buy requires clean empty cell, cash buffer, safe neighbors, forecast p>=.5, conservative lower>price+.02. Explicit endgame rule can veto, never a universal stationary payment. Measured lower bounds did not clear middle intervention.

prior_experiments.name: Full-game v4r planter spending
prior_experiments.exposure: whole original development matches on an older neural actor
prior_experiments.difference_from_source_always_pay: Neural argmax decides first. It can veto a selected stationary payment to preserve another hire. Moving planter is not forced to pay.

prior_experiments.name: Tree-raid
prior_experiments.exposure: whole original development matches on a different tree tactic
prior_experiments.difference_from_source_always_pay: Specialized raiding route head includes approaching and stealing opponent trees. Does not force every solitary affordable in-place plant and seizure in the two windows.

prior_experiments.name: Final-turn planting guard
prior_experiments.exposure: only final decision, cancels eligible new tree payment when justified
prior_experiments.difference_from_source_always_pay: Veto on final decision; preserves seizure. Changes the opposite side of the decision.

prior_experiments.name: Planter destinations
prior_experiments.exposure: earlier different actor, true-whole-game original parent/candidate
prior_experiments.difference_from_source_always_pay: Searches which destination to reach before later purchase, checks advantage of alternative. Not an unconditional buy on current square.

prior_experiments.name: Counterfactual intent head
prior_experiments.exposure: 56 trained native roots, prospective eight more
prior_experiments.difference_from_source_always_pay: Fits action-value difference including failed payments. Six interventions on leave-one-map-out all lost official margin; retrospective diagnostic then held roots stay with parent.

prior_experiments.name: Conditional response head
prior_experiments.exposure: same native branches, fit only fulfilled payments; no qualifying full-game test
prior_experiments.difference_from_source_always_pay: Per-root learned incremental purchase choice includes threshold and abstention; payoff conditioned on purchase is a different decision problem. Reported 18 flips, +14.59 across 16 maps, one-sided lower −48.57.

prior_experiments.name: Planter survival
prior_experiments.exposure: full original parent/candidate on two development maps
prior_experiments.difference_from_source_always_pay: Changes staying to evacuation where the planter is at risk, may deliberately surrender profitable tree purchases. Opposite direction from always pay.
